column1: # The mask at the input (the log mask contract «Mask at the input» mask_in; the white-space ones — the human name contract white_space): the value
# of a secret field sent for a write → a mask (a write refusal, P/06.2 N4) or a value. The form — README.

column4: the log mask and the secret display mask (`***`, the vectors log-mask and secret-in) at the input — a refusal
more than three characters of the set — a mask
fewer than three characters — a value
characters of the set mixed — a mask
a white-space one at the edge does not count (S12; acceptance P/06.2 sc. 02 step 5)
U+00A0 at the edge (S12; acceptance P/06.2 sc. 02 step 6)
U+3000 and U+2028 — White_Space white-space ones
U+200B is not White_Space — not an edge: a value
spaces inside — not characters of the set: a value
after the edge two characters — a value
a password with asterisks inside — a value (S12)
a character outside the set — a value
U+22C6 not from the set — a value
U+2027 not from the set — a value
empty — not a mask (fewer than three characters)
white-space ones only — no characters of the set: not a mask
